name: TargetExcelApplication
label: Target Excel Application
description: The Excel Application object where the data will be pasted.

name: SourceExcelApplication
label: Source Excel Application
description: The Excel Application object where the data is coming from.

name: SourceWorksheetName
label: Source Worksheet Name
description: Name of the worksheet in the source Excel instance containing the data to copy.

name: SourceRangeAddress
label: Source Range Address
description: The range address (e.g., 'A1:B10') in the source worksheet to copy.

name: PasteMode
label: Paste Mode
description: Specifies how to determine the paste location.

selectOptions.label: On Named Cells
selectOptions.description: Pastes data into a named range.

selectOptions.label: On Currently Active Cell
selectOptions.description: Pastes data starting from the currently active cell.

selectOptions.label: On Specified Cell
selectOptions.description: Pastes data starting from a specific column and row.

name: Name
label: Name
description: The name of the named range to paste into (required if 'Paste Mode' is 'On Named Cells').

name: Column
label: Column
description: The column letter (e.g., 'A', 'B') where the paste should begin (required if 'Paste Mode' is 'On Specified Cell').

name: Row
label: Row
description: The row number where the paste should begin (required if 'Paste Mode' is 'On Specified Cell').
